description: This file contains interface definitions and extension methods related to grain state serializers in the Orleans distributed application framework. It includes the IGrainStorageSerializer interface for serializing and deserializing grain state data, extension methods for serialization, and configuration options for storage serializers.

classes.name: GrainStorageSerializerExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for IGrainStorageSerializer, enabling additional serialization functionalities.

classes.name: IStorageProviderSerializerOptions
classes.description: Interface representing options for storage provider serializers, allowing retrieval and setting of the serializer used.

classes.name: DefaultStorageProviderSerializerOptionsConfigurator`1
classes.description: Generic class implementing post-configuration logic to assign default serializers if none are set.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes an object of type T into BinaryData.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes BinaryData into an object of type T.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Extension method that deserializes ReadOnlyMemory<byte> into an object of type T.

methods.name: PostConfigure
methods.description: Sets a default IGrainStorageSerializer for the options if it is not already set, using the service provider.
